newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia June trade surplus widens to record.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia June trade surplus widens to record.

text.p: Australia's seasonally adjusted balance on goods and services showed a surplus of A$1.964 billion in June compared to May's surplus of A$787 million, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
This was the largest on record and compares with a surplus of A$273 million in June 1996.
The Bureau of Statistics said exports of goods rose 23 percent due largely to the inclusion of A$1.8 billion of gold reserves sold by the Reserve Bank. Goods imports were up by nine percent.
EXPORTS: Rural goods 2.036 bln 2.012 bln 1.849 bln
IMPORTS: Consumption goods 1.983 bln 1.741 bln 1.660 bln
Balance of goods/svcs +1.964 bln +787 million +273 million
The Bureau said total exports of goods and services rose 20 percent, seasonally adjusted, while imports rose eight percent.

The trend estimate, which did not include exports of the RBA's gold sale, on the balance of goods and services recorded a surplus of A$167 million in June, the 16th consecutive surplus in this balance.

The bureau said seasonally adjusted capital goods imports rose 14 percent in June, and included civil aircraft which rose A$194 million, while consumption good imports rose 14 percent also, and intermediate imports rose four percent.
